propositions: Batched overlap-judge calls inherit generic 16,000-token and 600-second budgets with three structured retries and four transport retries, causing multi-minute delays and malformed oversized JSON responses before advisory abstention.
RunRequest lacks operation-local output token, structured-retry, transport-attempt, and timeout ceilings, allowing multiple long generations even when a token cap alone is applied.
The repair adds lowering-only request-local seams for structured retries, transport attempts, and timeout to RunRequest, then applies them in _effective_config before model construction.

Overlap judge calls must declare advisory budgets of 1,024 output tokens, one structured attempt, one transport attempt, and 60-second timeout to degrade timeout/truncation/malformed output promptly to all-candidate abstention.
Valid six-candidate verdicts under bounded request retain label-keyed mapping and relation aggregation behavior.
Existing callers omitting request-local limits retain current policy; the repair preserves byte-for-byte verdict demultiplexing outside budget metadata.
